concurrency_handling.description: This is a live shared working tree with 3 sibling tasks (265, 279, 241) actively committing during this dispatch. agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json had pre-existing uncommitted sibling line_count fixes (unrelated entries) at the start of this phase, and MORE accumulated during this phase's execution (siblings running their own --write concurrently).
concurrency_handling.isolation_method: Rather than running `git add` on the dirty working-tree file (which would have swept sibling line_count fixes into this task's commit), the commit was constructed from HEAD content plus exactly this task's 6 new entries via a temporary file-swap: (1) backed up the full dirty working-tree file, (2) wrote a clean HEAD+6-entries version to disk, (3) ran git-commit-scoped.sh against that clean content, (4) restored the backed-up dirty content afterward so sibling in-flight work remains present and uncommitted in the working tree for their own commit.
